description:
Hushfeed v0.17.0 targets global TikTok 46.2.3 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

Patching now fits the memory Morphe Manager gives by default. The settings text moved out of TikTok's resources and into the patch's own code, and screen capture detection stopped asking for resources it did not need, so the default set of patches finishes in 512 MB instead of 768. AMOLED dark theme rewrites colours and still needs 768.

New in this release: the settings screen speaks Indonesian, a video's sound can be saved as its own .m4a, an animated sticker can be saved as MP4, GIF or the WebP TikTok sent, and a long press on a profile picture saves the full size original.

Validation: 270 runtime tests passed locally. The bundle carries 64 patches and passed checks for all three DEX payloads; 63 of them applied to a stock 46.2.3 APK in one run. Phone installation has not been verified.

The downloadable .mpp is the patch bundle. Patch on the device with Morphe Manager and keep its existing signing key.
